risks.risk: Watt rating may not be 300W (or may be per panel vs total), which directly changes market value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel rating label (nameplate) showing Wp (e.g., 300W), model, and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed 300W (worst case: treat as lower-rated/unknown output).

risks.risk: Brand/model may not be Suntex (seller text could be inaccurate).

risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown brand solar panel.

risks.risk: Monocrystalline claim may be wrong (could be polycrystalline or mixed), affecting value.
risks.proof: Close-up of the label/specs stating cell type (mono/poly) or a clear view of cell appearance plus label confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed (worst case: treat as lower-value type).

risks.risk: Condition and functionality are unknown (panel could be cracked, degraded, or damaged).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the glass surface for cracks/chips and the junction box/backs; plus an IV curve test or at least a working test report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested until proven.

risks.proof: Confirm how many panels are included and whether each is 300W; take a photo showing both labels or a count with labels visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the worst-case interpretation (only one panel at the stated rating, unless proven otherwise).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the panel rating label/nameplate (brand, model, Wp, voltage/current, serial).
Photos showing both panels’ labels (if two are included) so quantity and per-panel wattage are confirmed.
Close-ups of the glass for cracks/chips and the junction box/MC4 connectors.
A simple performance proof: IV curve test or a documented test showing output under sun/standard conditions.
